title: Skystack
tagline: One tap. One slab. Stack from a meadow island through the clouds and aurora into orbit.
description: A one-tap tower stacker in 3D. Slabs slide across the top of your tower — tap to drop, and anything hanging over the edge is sliced off and tumbles away. Land a perfect drop for a chime that climbs the scale; chain them and the slab grows back. As the tower rises the sky turns from morning blue through golden sunset into an aurora night and finally space, with milestones at the Treetops, Cloud Sea, Aurora, Stratosphere and Orbit (100 slabs). Classic is pure skill, Wind adds gusts that shove the slab mid-slide, and Zen never ends: a miss just lands a smaller slab.
controls: Tap / click anywhere or press Space to drop · Esc/P pause
fablePass: Music: airy ambient bed that thins with altitude (wind → choir pad → space hum)
Slab land: squash-and-settle animation and dust puff on cuts
Sky: birds near the Treetops, aircraft contrails in the Stratosphere, satellite at Orbit
Game over: tower-top camera fly-down with the run's highlights
